title: hunch task verify default timeout (120s) is far below the suite's runtime and verification_argv gives no timeout hint, so full-suite checks record as timed out
observation: DEFAULT_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS is 120s and the verification_argv returned by hunch_task start carries no --timeout, so an agent that follows the card instruction and runs `npm test` through the wrapper records a timed-out failed check even when the suite would pass. Observed 2026-09-16 in this repo: a prior task's `npm test` check timed out at 120s; a re-run with --timeout 600 also timed out (exit 1, timed_out true) with 1800 of ~2026 tests already passed, because the local suite exceeds 10 minutes when dist/ exists (agent-farm-season.test.ts alone ran 417s). The timed-out check then surfaces in the card as a failed verification and in the RECENT TASKS line as 'Verification command: timed out', which is misleading memory for the next agent.
